title: EntitlementChecked
description: A concessionary or staff entitlement was checked against the register. Subject-linked because the entitlement is held by a person and the check is a lookup of whether this person holds it - the class alone answers nothing.

subject_ref.description: Pairwise pseudonym of the traveller, issued by identity-gateway for the `transit` domain. Required to look the entitlement up in the register.

entitlement.description: Entitlement checked. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

valid.description: Whether the entitlement was in force at check time.

expires_at.description: When the entitlement expires, if it is valid.

asset_ref.description: Vehicle the check was performed on.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
